worldcombat.skill.petaldance.summary: Dance in motion inside a hollow ring of petals: the outer edge cuts and nudges whoever it sweeps past, while the open centre stays safe; petals are left where the user passes. Afterwards the user reels in confusion and its actions may fumble.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.use.0: Shave a ring of approaching enemies with the outer petal edge
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.use.1: Handle a crowd of low Sp. Def targets with special damage
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.use.2: Walk the skirt edge onto enemies while leaving the safe open centre for allies
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.description: Dances %2$s rings along the current aim, each dealing about %1$s special damage to every foe on the outer petal edge.

The skirt's outer radius is %1$s blocks and its open centre is %2$s of that (targets closer than this sit in the safe hollow); rings are %3$s apart; each ring drifts %4$s blocks along an arc and nudges those on the edge %5$s blocks outward.
Each ring leaves up to %1$s petal patches on genuinely supporting ground; they last %2$s before the petals vanish and the blocks revert.

Afterwards the user is dazed for %1$s: each attempted action has a %2$s chance to be broken and wasted, and a fumble also cuts the user for a sliver of maximum health; the backlash does not extend the daze.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.drift.on: Whirling form: drifts further, storms wider, petals last longer and the daze lasts longer, but each ring is slightly weaker (×0.96) and the wind-up and cooldown are longer.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.drift.off: Grounded form: spins in place, recovers faster and loses control for less time, but the radius and the trace left behind are narrower.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP; cooldown %5$s s after casting.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.growth.0: From level %1$s each ring rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.growth.1: From level %1$s each ring rises to %2$s and leaves %3$s petal patches.
On: drifts further, storms wider, petals last longer and the daze lasts longer, but each ring is slightly weaker (×0.96) with a slower wind-up and cooldown - good for kiting. Off (grounded): spins in place, recovers faster and loses control for less time, but the radius and the trace left behind are narrower.
The companion only considers the dance when the threat is this close; smaller waits until contact, larger closes in first.
At least this many non-allies must stand inside the storm radius before dancing; larger only uses it when surrounded, 1 uses it on sight.
On: leaves a hold or stay post to dance into a crowd. Off: only dances when it reaches someone from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.petaldance.description: The user keeps free movement through the dance and the skirt travels with its real body; the dance cannot be interrupted and only ends when it finishes.
